subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All games are entertainment. All entertainment is fun.

Conclusions:

I. All games are fun

II. Some fun is entertainment.
solution:
Given Statements:

All games are entertainment.

All entertainment is fun.

From statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244a616050e57baa557d578275ed702456dcf4b09decf18ade0b3c85838dbc3e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All games are fun → **True** (since games are part of fun)

II. Some fun is entertainment → **True** (since all entertainment is part of fun, so at least some fun is entertainment)

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
